diagnostic.accuracy_scope: numerical dense/scalar reference; no formal quantum/optimizer guarantee

controls.virtual_budget_scope: CPU-control annotations only; no real or modeled quantum shot consumption
controls.method: deterministic exact-moment CPU control; no sampling or QPU execution
controls.timing_scope: measured CPU reference and controller times; no hardware performance measurement

settings.polling_order: axis ascending, minus then plus; fresh incumbent each sweep
settings.tie_break: first minimum in frozen polling order
settings.acceptance_semantics: strict exact reduction exceeds descriptive margin; no confidence/convergence claim

limitations: deterministic exact-reference CPU controls; no RNG, counts or quantum preparations
virtual allocations enter only the expected-margin annotation
fixed schedule exhaustion supplies no convergence or hardware-performance certificate
population variances remain state properties even when effective comparison SE is zero

controls.method: deterministic exact-moment CPU control; no sampling or QPU execution
controls.timing_scope: measured CPU reference and controller times; no hardware performance measurement

settings.polling_order: axis ascending, minus then plus; fresh incumbent each sweep
settings.tie_break: first minimum in frozen polling order
settings.acceptance_semantics: strict exact reduction exceeds descriptive margin; no confidence/convergence claim

limitations: deterministic exact-reference CPU controls; no RNG, counts or quantum preparations
virtual allocations enter only the expected-margin annotation
fixed schedule exhaustion supplies no convergence or hardware-performance certificate
population variances remain state properties even when effective comparison SE is zero

diagnostic.method: independent all-assignment XOR enumeration and algebraic phase/bit-pair mixer evolution

controls.oracle_evaluation_scope: exact bounded CPU polling-objective calls; final audit counted separately; no quantum oracle calls
controls.virtual_budget_scope: CPU-control annotations only; no real or modeled quantum shot consumption
controls.method: deterministic exact-moment CPU control; no sampling or QPU execution
controls.timing_scope: measured CPU reference and controller times; no hardware performance measurement

settings.polling_order: axis ascending, minus then plus; fresh incumbent each sweep
settings.tie_break: first minimum in frozen polling order
settings.acceptance_semantics: strict exact reduction exceeds descriptive margin; no confidence/convergence claim

limitations: deterministic exact-reference CPU controls; no RNG, counts or quantum preparations
virtual allocations enter only the expected-margin annotation
fixed schedule exhaustion supplies no convergence or hardware-performance certificate
population variances remain state properties even when effective comparison SE is zero

diagnostic.method: independent all-assignment XOR enumeration and algebraic phase/bit-pair mixer evolution

settings.acceptance_semantics: strict exact reduction exceeds descriptive margin; no confidence/convergence claim

virtual allocations enter only the expected-margin annotation
fixed schedule exhaustion supplies no convergence or hardware-performance certificate
population variances remain state properties even when effective comparison SE is zero

diagnostic.accuracy_scope: numerical dense/scalar reference; no formal quantum/optimizer guarantee

settings.tie_break: first minimum in frozen polling order
settings.acceptance_semantics: strict exact reduction exceeds descriptive margin; no confidence/convergence claim

limitations: deterministic exact-reference CPU controls; no RNG, counts or quantum preparations
virtual allocations enter only the expected-margin annotation
fixed schedule exhaustion supplies no convergence or hardware-performance certificate
population variances remain state properties even when effective comparison SE is zero

diagnostic.hamiltonian: -sum_i Z_i+0.5 sum_i X_i X_(i+1); open chain
diagnostic.method: independent Pauli-tensor Hamiltonian/eigvalsh and RY-product/CNOT-permutation state
diagnostic.timing_scope: bounded classical reference CPU wall time; no hardware preparation or feedback
diagnostic.accuracy_scope: numerical dense/scalar reference; no formal quantum/optimizer guarantee

fixed schedule exhaustion supplies no convergence or hardware-performance certificate
population variances remain state properties even when effective comparison SE is zero

controls.oracle_evaluation_scope: exact bounded CPU polling-objective calls; final audit counted separately; no quantum oracle calls
controls.virtual_budget_scope: CPU-control annotations only; no real or modeled quantum shot consumption
controls.method: deterministic exact-moment CPU control; no sampling or QPU execution
controls.timing_scope: measured CPU reference and controller times; no hardware performance measurement

settings.polling_order: axis ascending, minus then plus; fresh incumbent each sweep
settings.tie_break: first minimum in frozen polling order
settings.acceptance_semantics: strict exact reduction exceeds descriptive margin; no confidence/convergence claim

limitations: deterministic exact-reference CPU controls; no RNG, counts or quantum preparations
virtual allocations enter only the expected-margin annotation
fixed schedule exhaustion supplies no convergence or hardware-performance certificate
population variances remain state properties even when effective comparison SE is zero

diagnostic.hamiltonian: -sum_i Z_i+0.5 sum_i X_i X_(i+1); open chain
diagnostic.method: independent Pauli-tensor Hamiltonian/eigvalsh and RY-product/CNOT-permutation state
diagnostic.timing_scope: bounded classical reference CPU wall time; no hardware preparation or feedback
diagnostic.accuracy_scope: numerical dense/scalar reference; no formal quantum/optimizer guarantee

exact_diagnostics_scope: sampled optimizer decisions only; CPU controls explicitly use exact moments
quality_selection: every frozen case/start/seed, every miss and inconclusive holdout retained
limitations: ideal CPU sampling only; no hardware-calibrated noise, predictive convergence or quantum advantage
matched training preparations do not match gate, synthesis or physical costs
CPU controls use exact moments, not zero-shot quantum algorithms or expected stochastic paths
no global ansatz optimum or infeasibility certified by failed local polling
holdout confidence is conditional on frozen final states and excludes adaptive training
source ledger excludes unmeasured physical reset, routing, synthesis, fault correction and feedback
Classical C4 reference coverage only

device.backend: CPU Qiskit Statevector, NumPy PCG64 ideal sampling and independent dense references

provenance.revision_note: Checkout revision identifies the base; captured content hashes identify executed code
